name: io.github.flashdata-dev/youtube-trainability
title: YouTube License Metadata — FlashData
description: YouTube Creative Commons license-label metadata, not training authorization. Paid FlashData API.

environmentVariables.name: FLASHDATA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your FlashData API Key with youtube_trainability access. Get a key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys; data calls are paid.

dev.flashdata.task: Inspect YouTube Creative Commons license labels
dev.flashdata.useResult: Read results[0].permitted together with videoId and collection time. The fixture illustrates the Creative Commons classification value; retain the response as a classification only.
dev.flashdata.limits: The tool name is youtube_trainability, but it checks a license label. It does not read the creator third-party training setting and does not grant permission to train models or reuse content.
dev.flashdata.installation: Local MCPB / stdio; Node.js >=22.18.0; set your own FLASHDATA_API_KEY in protected client settings. See guideUrl for manual setup.
dev.flashdata.billing: MIT software and installation are free. FlashData data calls use paid Credits. Pricing/job/result reads are free; client and model fees are separate.
